findings.title: Payout example grants invocation to read-only and billing collaborators
findings.description: The document defines __managers__ as the owner plus every collaborator, while viewer is explicitly a read-only role and billing is separately scoped. Nevertheless, the money-moving runPayouts function authorizes all __managers__. A lower-privileged viewer or billing collaborator is still a collaborator and can therefore invoke payouts despite their narrower control role.
findings.recommendation: Gate payout invocation on __owners__, a deliberately selected __admins__ role, or a dedicated custom payout role. Do not use the union-style __managers__ set for money movement.

findings.title: Denied read behavior is incorrectly documented as HTTP 403
findings.description: The page claims non-managers reading ops receive 403. Bounded intentionally hides denied reads as successful HTTP 200 responses with null or empty data; only denied writes and function invokes return 403. Code or tests copied from this statement will misclassify an access denial as a missing record or wait for an error that never occurs.
findings.recommendation: State that denied reads return HTTP 200 with empty data, while a denied create returns 403.
